video.title: San Antonio Spurs NBA Season Preview | Wemby MVP Season Loading

summary: This is the last team preview in the series. Josh Lord talks with Matthew Tynen of Locked On Spurs about the Spurs after they reached the NBA Finals and lost to the Knicks. The expected starting five is De'Aaron Fox, Stephon Castle, Devin Vassell, Tobias Harris and Victor Wembanyama. Dylan Harper starts on the bench but should push toward 30 minutes, and Castle is expected to lead the guards in minutes. Tobias Harris was signed to help on the defensive glass and to give the team a post and isolation scorer. The forward group is very deep, which squeezes Keldon Johnson and Harrison Barnes. Wembanyama's blocks and contests dropped because teams stopped attacking him at the rim, and Tynen expects that trend to continue. Fox played the playoffs through a high ankle sprain and lost his burst. Tynen predicts 63 wins because the Western Conference looks weaker.

rules.text: A weaker conference can add wins for the strong teams in it.
rules.quote: I just think that the Western Conference is down and I think that's going to result in in at least one more win

player_notes.text: The rookie is recovering from an operation. The early timetable was about six months, and the team has not ruled him out for the season. He could play at some point this season, but it is uncertain.

player_notes.text: If he stays healthy, he is projected to become a dominant defensive player.
player_notes.quote: eventually he is probably going to be a pretty dominating defensive player

player_notes.text: He is still a very good defensive rebounder for his position. He was signed to shore up the defensive boards at the four.
player_notes.quote: he's still a very good defensive rebounder at his position

player_notes.text: He is still a strong isolation and post scorer. He gives the team someone to hand the ball to when the offense bogs down.
player_notes.quote: Tobias Harris is still very strong as an ISO uh, scorer, a postcorer

player_notes.quote: not to mention like is he streaky from the three-point line? Yes. Do you still have to respect him

player_notes.text: He is projected to start at power forward.
player_notes.quote: it's going to be Fox and Castle Deon Vel Tobias Harris Victor Romanyama

player_notes.text: He is expected to come off the bench to start the year. He will have to earn a starting spot outright.
player_notes.quote: he is absolutely going to have to earn it outright

player_notes.text: Even off the bench, he is expected to push toward 30 minutes, along with Fox and Castle.
player_notes.quote: I do think that that those three guys are going to be pushing the 30 minute mark

player_notes.text: The team sees him as a future superstar and part of the long-term backcourt with Castle.
player_notes.quote: they know that Dylan Harper is a superstar

player_notes.text: The host is skeptical of his late-season shooting. If it holds, he would be a top five player in the league.
player_notes.quote: But hey, if that holds, then you're talking a top five player in the league.
player_notes.value_hint: top five player if the shooting holds

player_notes.text: He is a much better defender than people think.
player_notes.quote: Dylan Harper who's a much better defender than I think people may may think he is

player_notes.text: He suffered a serious high ankle sprain in the Minnesota series. He came back in about 10 days from what is normally a four to six week injury and was clearly not himself.
player_notes.quote: clearly hampered by the pretty serious high ankle sprain that he suffered in the Minnesota series

player_notes.text: He will start alongside Castle. The team still has a lot of faith in him.
player_notes.quote: it's going to be Darren Fox and Steph Castle to start the to start the games

player_notes.text: He often started possessions off the ball. Castle initiated the offense and Fox was used as a secondary weapon.
player_notes.quote: De'Arren's going to be starting off the ball a lot more

player_notes.text: The host says his scoring, free throw shooting, three-point shooting and steals were all down last season.
player_notes.quote: Like his scoring is down, his shooting was bad from the line, his three-point shooting was down

player_notes.text: After the injury he lost his downhill burst. A healthy Fox is described as the key ceiling raiser for the Spurs.
player_notes.quote: the element that was missing like very clearly was the downhill burst

player_notes.text: He is expected to lead the guard trio in minutes because of his versatility on both ends.
player_notes.quote: it would be Steph Castle who leads that trio in minutes

player_notes.text: He is a versatile defender. He can guard positions one through three, sometimes fours, and even small-ball fives.
player_notes.quote: defending one through three on the court if not fours

player_notes.text: Creating and facilitating is more natural and repeatable for him than his shooting.

player_notes.text: Turnovers are a problem. His turnovers were eye-popping in the first two games of the Oklahoma City series, which Fox missed.
player_notes.quote: his turnover issues were were eye popping

player_notes.text: The Spurs used him as the primary initiator of the offense.
player_notes.quote: they utilize Steph Castle as the head of the snake

player_notes.text: His shooting is improving. He made his free throws in the Finals.
player_notes.quote: His shooting is starting to come along, he was nailing his free throws in the finals.

player_notes.text: He is much less comfortable scoring going left. The Knicks forced him left and shut him down.
player_notes.quote: he is not nearly as comfortable uh operating as a scorer going left and driving left

player_notes.text: He used to be a high-usage player, but his role has been reduced.
player_notes.quote: He's a high usage player and now his role has been reduced.

player_notes.text: He has become an across-the-board Swiss Army knife. He scores, shoots, rebounds, defends and works as a secondary playmaker.
player_notes.quote: he has just become this across the board sort of Swiss Army knife

player_notes.text: He showed defense and shot blocking in the postseason. He is entrenched in the rotation.
player_notes.quote: We saw the defense, the shot blocking in the postseason.

player_notes.text: He is still learning to score one-on-one when given the ball. That is not yet a strength of his game.
player_notes.quote: he's still learning how to be a guy to that you can just give the ball to

player_notes.text: He was one of the team's best free throw shooters all season, though he missed a lot in the Finals.
player_notes.quote: Victor Winyama included, who was one of their best free throw shooters all season

player_notes.text: His block and contest numbers dropped because teams stopped challenging him at the rim.
player_notes.quote: His block numbers have decreased. His amount of shots that he contests has decreased.

player_notes.text: Tynen expects teams to keep avoiding shots at the rim against him in the regular season.
player_notes.quote: I think the trend in large part will continue that teams are not going to put the ball up around the basket

player_notes.text: This is a contract year for him.
player_notes.quote: Kell Johnson, this is a contract year for him.

player_notes.text: He is reliable and available every night.
player_notes.quote: you can count on him to be there every single night

player_notes.text: He is likely on the outside of the rotation on many nights. He signed a one-year, $8 million deal.
player_notes.quote: Harrison Barnes is probably the guy who is going to be on the outside looking in a lot of nights

player_notes.text: He took over as the starting four around the middle of last season, which cut Barnes's minutes.

player_notes.quote: undersized fours, someone like a Julian Champeni or a Harrison Barnes to clean up the glass

player_notes.text: He is the next young forward coming up, which puts more pressure on Barnes's minutes.

player_notes.quote: Jeremy Sohan asked out at the at the midpoint of this past season

team_notes.text: The Spurs are still aggressive about winning now. They have cap flexibility and made only small roster changes.
team_notes.quote: they haven't had to switch much up with the roster. they have a little bit of time before

team_notes.text: The team drafted three centers and replaced older backup centers with younger ones. It lost no one who played rotation minutes.
team_notes.quote: a rotating cast of a million sort of depth centers, but they've just gone a lot younger

team_notes.text: Projected starters are Fox, Castle, Vassell, Harris and Wembanyama.
team_notes.quote: it's going to be Fox and Castle Deon Vel Tobias Harris Victor Romanyama

team_notes.text: The team staggers its three guards so that at least two are always on the court. Expect more three-guard lineups this season.

team_notes.text: The roster is very deep at forward. Consolidation through trades is expected in the relatively near future, but not right now.

team_notes.text: Coach Mitch Johnson will have his hands full balancing a deep rotation. The locker room culture is strong.
